description: This file defines the AverageAnglePanel class, a Swing UI component that displays average angles computed from sensor data, and includes UI controls and sensor data listeners.

classes.name: AverageAnglePanel
classes.description: UI component that visualizes average angles based on sensor data, with controls for resetting and display area.

methods.name: AverageAnglePanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel, button, sensor listener, and layout.

methods.name: showResults
methods.description: Updates the text area with the latest report from AverageAngles.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel containing the UI components.
